**Diagnosis:** Date based deprecations are blocked in several version-only paths. [warnings.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/common/warnings.py:21) always records a `version` key, while [basic.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:728) has no `date` argument. Its exit formatting already preserves the required order for recorded entries, strings, and two-tuples, but discards `date` from dictionary entries ([basic.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:2022)).

Argument deprecations also need date handling in [parameters.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/common/parameters.py:125) and the alias path in [basic.py](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/basic.py:1401). The [validator schema](/app/test/lib/ansible_test/_data/sanity/validate-modules/validate_modules/schema.py:117) and [expiry checks](/app/test/lib/ansible_test/_data/sanity/validate-modules/validate_modules/main.py:1479) assume versions. [Display.deprecated](/app/lib/ansible/utils/display.py:252) accepts no date, though callbacks pass deprecation entries to it as keyword arguments. C# [Deprecate and alias validation](/app/lib/ansible/module_utils/csharp/Ansible.Basic.cs:245) likewise accept only versions.

A fix should preserve the existing version and ordering behavior, add date shaped output and display, reject simultaneous version and date in `AnsibleModule.deprecate`, and validate C# alias entries with the specified exact errors and `DateTime` formatting. Existing inspected tests cover version behavior; I found no date cases. This is a code based diagnosis, so behavior beyond those paths remains unverified.

I updated [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). Project source and tests were left unchanged under the specialist instructions, so the issue is **not yet resolved**.

Implemented date based module deprecations across Python and C#. Date entries now reach `exit_json()` in call order, display includes the removal date, and the validator and C# alias path accept and check date targets. `AnsibleModule.deprecate()` raises the required assertion when both a version and date are set.

Five focused Python tests passed, as did `compileall` and `git diff --check`. I could not run the C# integration test because PowerShell is unavailable, or the validator runtime check because `voluptuous` is unavailable.
